==============================

Platform: Windows x64
Toolchain: Visual Studio 2022, MSVC 19.44.35228, Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0
RmlUi linkage: Shared library

RmlUi options:

  RMLUI_SAMPLES=OFF
  BUILD_TESTING=OFF
  RMLUI_LUA_BINDINGS=OFF

header set is byte-for-byte identical to ThirdParty/RmlUi/Include/RmlUi.
